access_note: The source catalogue states restricted access under NDA. It does not publish the agreement, an application procedure or permission to reuse the underlying observations.
description: The ILU project catalogue describes geolocated speed data from Waze users in Lisbon, provided through the Lisbon municipality and the Waze API. It lists Waze as creator and explicitly restricts access under a non-disclosure agreement. The relation table records use in E2PAT emerging-traffic-pattern analysis and a distinct road-congestion biclustering study. This establishes an infrastructure-analysis input role, without treating the observations as a complete census of road users or a current traffic service. The exact collection dates, sampling interval, spatial accuracy, API route, file format and record count are unspecified. No generic Waze feed is substituted for this historical research collection. The descriptive catalogue is available, but access to the underlying speeds requires unpublished terms. The related E2PAT model uses these inputs; cost and licence conditions remain unknown.
